# UX Checklist: Árvores de fórmula ao vivo e painéis por sistema

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the UX requirements of spec 008: the side panel, the panel that follows the game screen, the Formulas tab, the extras (Pin, Before/after, Where this goes, patch radar, farm tracker), states and accessibility.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the companion's behavior defined when the player leaves a system screen for a screen that has no panel (map, town, menu)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are the states of the Formulas tab, the system panels and the side panel defined before the first reading and with no character selected? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is the place on screen of the farm tracker defined? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK004 Is the place on screen of the patch radar defined, and when it appears? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK005 Is the way to pin and unpin a number defined, and what happens on a sixth pin? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK006 Is the way to create, name, pick and clear a mark defined, and what happens on a fourth mark? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK007 Is the order of the groups in the Formulas tab specified? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the widened window size quantified, and is the side the window grows to specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Is the short answer at the top of a tree specified with its exact wording and its fallbacks (a tree with no sum, no multiplier)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 Is every honesty tag specified with the exact text the player reads? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK011 Is the "% of max" text of diminishing returns specified with an example and its limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Do the rules for the side panel (fixed until ✕ or another tree) and the panel that always follows the screen hold together without conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 Is the language of the whole interface and of the trees stated (English)? [Consistency, Gap]

## Accessibility

- [x] CHK014 Are the keyboard requirements of the tree specified key by key? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK015 Is it defined where the keyboard focus goes when the panel switches by itself and when the side panel opens and closes? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK016 Is it defined what a screen reader announces when the panel switches by itself, when "Game changed" lights up and when a pin changes? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-024, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK017 Are the 200% zoom requirements stated for the main panel, the pin strip and the Formulas tab, not only for the tree? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-031]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Is the "panel appears in up to 1 s after the screen opens" target measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK019 Is the 5-second test written as a repeatable script with a pass condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
